The '''Equator City First Stage''' was a performance arts stage located in [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia's]] [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]]. It hosted ''[[The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma]]'' in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
